Hanger Series: Notes and Footnotes (Simpson Strong-Tie Joist Hangers - C-C-2026 & strongtie.com):
1. Uplift loads have been increased by C_D = 1.60 for wind or earthquake loading with no further increase allowed. Reduce where other load durations govern.

Carried Width W (in.): HGUS): Joist nails must be driven at an angle through the joist/truss into the header to achieve listed loads. Using 0.148" x 1-1/2" (10d x 1-1/2") joist nails instead of 0.148" x 3" double-shear nails reduces download capacity to approx. 0.64x of tabulated double-shear load.

Hanger Series: 3. Carrying Member (Header) Thickness Requirement: Tabulated loads for 3 in. (0.148"x3" or 0.162"x3.5") header nails require a minimum 3 in. (2-ply 2x) carrying member. For single 2x (1-1/2 in.) headers
use 1-1/2 in. header fasteners and apply the single-ply header reduction table.

Hanger Series: 4. Multi-Ply Carried Members: Fasten multi-ply joists/trusses together to act as a single unit before or after hanger installation so loads are shared equally across plies.
5. HUCQ hangers use 1/4 in. Strong-Drive SDS Heavy-Duty Connector Screws (supplied with hangers). Minimum carrying member thickness is 3 in. for SDS2.5 screws.
